hook.text: The opening riff of 'Ye Entrancemperium' comes from an unnamed Mayhem track, so the liner notes credit guitarist Euronymous.

facts.label: Recorded
facts.value: October to December 1996 at Grieg Hall, Bergen, Norway

facts.label: Players
facts.value: Ihsahn (vocals, guitar, synthesizer), Samoth (guitar), Alver (bass), Trym (drums and percussion)

sentences.text: This was the band's second studio album, and its lyrics began to shift away from nature and Satanic subjects and to take in more mystical themes.
In 1996 the EP Reverence came out as a teaser for it, and it included the track 'The Loss and Curse of Reverence'.
Compared with In the Nightside Eclipse, the band's previous album, this one sounds faster and more guitar-driven, with fewer keyboards, more clean singing and more blast-beat drumming.
Ihsahn and Samoth both handled the arrangements and the mastering, and Pytten handled the engineering.
